protocol.development: Existing 24 development scenes; may be used to assess or revise the candidate.
protocol.freeze_rule: Choose the neural checkpoint using training/validation/development only; record its hash before the new confirmation partition is evaluated. Previous physics-reference confirmation scenes are not a fresh test for this iteration.
protocol.inference_rule: Improved dynamics must return network outputs directly. No calibrated coefficients, contact response replacement, simulator queries or truth-based action selection.

limitation: One trained checkpoint per method in a deterministic simulator. Extra training data, geometric inputs, architecture and optimization all changed. No claim of single-factor causation or general robot reliability.
